title: Reply deadline escalation
summary: Escalates tickets or requests nobody has answered within your deadline, to a lead and the assignee.
description: Every 30 minutes, finds rows that have sat in a waiting status (new, open, waiting on us) for longer than your deadline, stamps them escalated_at and notifies the role you choose, plus the assigned person when you name one. When a row moves back into the waiting status its clock restarts, so a second wait can escalate again.

params.name: ticket
params.label: Tickets table
params.description: The table of tickets, requests or enquiries that need a reply.

params.name: waiting_value
params.label: Waiting status
params.description: The status value that means a reply is owed.

params.name: hours
params.label: Deadline in hours
params.description: How many hours a row may wait before it escalates.

params.name: escalate_role
params.label: Escalate to
params.description: The role told about late rows.

params.name: assignee_ref
params.label: Assigned person
params.description: Optional: the ref naming who should reply, so they are told too.

notes: A table with a status enum that has a waiting value.

includes: A workflow that restarts the clock when a row waits again
highlights: Escalates once per wait, never repeatedly
Tells the assignee and the lead
